claim: Make black see-through only where it connects to the outside: flood from outside edge, treat small gaps as walls, and keep enclosed black solid.

evidence.text: Mask G3 (user chose, replacing B): black is see-through only via gaps of at least 3x3 from outside; explosions B2-B8 keep B (enclosed black only).
evidence.quote: through only via gaps >= 3x3 from outside; explosions B2-B8 keep B (enclosed black only).

evidence.text: Scenery masks come from a whole-level sky flood, keyed by cell content, with 1-2 px gaps as walls; per-cell runtime floods were too slow.
evidence.quote: sky flood, keyed by cell content, with 1-2 px gaps as walls, cost one lookup per staged cell.
